name: 19122 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19122 (Philadelphia) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19122 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19122 (Philadelphia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
